resources.string: Draw special characters on the letters instead of gesture typing
Swiping across the letters draws a symbol; gesture typing is off. Taps, long presses and the space and delete swipes stay as they are.

Draw on the letter keys. Strokes that follow within a short pause belong to the same symbol (≠, ÷, €); the pause starts at 0.9 seconds and adapts to your pace (0.6 to 1.5 seconds). While you draw, the strip shows the symbol that would be written now; a tap on it writes it at once. After the pause the symbol is typed and the strip offers up to three alternatives. A tap that hardly moves types the symbol and then the letter; it only counts as a dot where a symbol needs one (÷). Further strokes may also start on punctuation keys. Not in password fields.
Recognized locally on the phone. Nothing is sent. Drawings are only saved as personal templates, when you calibrate or turn on learning below.
Draw a symbol three times and choose the text it types (up to 8 characters, emoji too). Own symbols are recognized together with the built-in ones.
Draw the symbol in the box, with up to 12 strokes.
At most 12 strokes. Please draw it again.
Drawn for too long. Please draw it again.
Not recognized yet; end the drawing now

When you pick another symbol from the strip, the drawing is kept as a personal template of that symbol (up to 3 per symbol, the newest win; a drawing with a dot only for a symbol with dots). Locally only; only with personalized suggestions on; not in incognito mode, while learning is paused or the device is locked.
Your own handwriting of known symbols, from the calibration and from your corrections. They are recognized together with the built-in ones.
Draw each built-in symbol twice in your own handwriting. You can skip a symbol or stop at any time; what you drew so far is kept.
Personal templates of “Draw symbols”: %1$d drawings (deleted together with everything learned)
